mapper.select: SELECT o.member_user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.phone_number, g.phone_number) AS phone_number FROM ticket_orders o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.member_user_id LEFT JOIN guest_order_infos g ON g.ticket_order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{ticketOrderId}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(u.phone_number, g.phone_number, 'ORDER:' || o.id)) o.member_user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.phone_number, g.phone_number) AS phone_number, o.id AS sample_ticket_order_id FROM issued_tickets it JOIN ticket_order_items oi ON oi.id = it.ticket_order_item_id JOIN ticket_orders o ON o.id = oi.ticket_order_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.member_user_id LEFT JOIN guest_order_infos g ON g.ticket_order_id = o.id WHERE it.expo_id = #{expoId} AND it.status IN ('ISSUED', 'CHECKED_IN') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_refunds r WHERE r.ticket_order_id = o.id ) ORDER BY COALESCE(u.phone_number, g.phone_number, 'ORDER:' || o.id), o.id
